gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern and businesslike, a plain sans with a tall x-height and generously opened curves. Galaxy sits above it, loose and stencil-bold.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC reads approachable, its curves left open at every end and its capitals nearly level with the lowercase. Galaxy is built for commanding, widely spaced display lines; Carrois Gothic SC is built for the quieter work of everyday text.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-chivo: Approachable and sturdy, Chivo keeps its lowercase packed up toward the caps with daylight in every curve. Galaxy goes cosmic and wide-spaced up top, and Chivo, a steady sans-serif, does the plain talking below.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-chocolate-classical: Galaxy's defining trait is a line width that never changes, with stems and arcs locked together at a single thickness. Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a large lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-comme: Galaxy brings a cosmic, stencil-like swagger, with bowls that keep their full width at the sides and loose spacing all around. Comme, a smooth sans, can run a touch larger.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-cossette-texte: Wide-eyed and bold, this pair splits the work cleanly. Galaxy is dense, loose and commanding, and Cossette Texte settles underneath with open lowercase e shapes, sturdy n arches and a prominent x-height.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-duru-sans: Stencil-cut and starry, Galaxy cuts letters at one steady width. Duru Sans, a plain sans with wide openings on its small letters, lets the lowercase dominate each line while its ascenders barely show.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-fresca: Clean and modern, Fresca keeps its counters open to the outside, with short ascenders above big bowls. Its strongest quality is that Galaxy's loose, cosmic display lines meet a sans-serif with no calligraphic thinning at all.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans leaves tiny gaps between its ascender tops and the x-height line, and its lowercase e opens like a pried clasp. Strokes hold their width from stem to curve, and Galaxy's loose cosmic display letters do the same.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-gafata: Flat, contrast-free and cosmic, Galaxy leads with dense lowercase and loose spacing. And Gafata follows in a tall band with short stalks and wide-eyed e shapes, so a long passage would read smoothly.
